integrity: Original full-length manuscript text and executable finite checker are included. Earlier papers and their established inequalities are attributed. Bibliographic completeness and independent validation are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to two nonempty types on fully occupied cycles with equal neighbor utilities and adjacent mutually strictly profitable swaps; no extension to nonlocal, multitype, vacancies, or stochastic settings is proved. The unbounded statement is analytical; finite checks are auxiliary.
title: Exact local-swap price of anarchy on two-type Schelling cycles
